instruction: GUI-only requirement: Launch Revit from the Revit shortcut or the provided application launch, then complete the task entirely in the Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, model views, properties, families already available in the project, and built-in IFC export commands. Open the provided seed IFC from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit before editing. The seed IFC is intentionally prepared with stable base geometry so the task can be completed through reliable Revit GUI edits: keep the existing floor slab and other useful seed elements unless the task explicitly asks you to add or rename something. If the imported IFC space is not available as a native Revit Room, place a new Room in the bounded area and use a Room Schedule or room properties to set the required room name. Seed split into lobby and office. The seed already contains the exterior shell, one floor slab, one partition wall, one exterior door, one interior door, and windows. The partition and hosted door/window elements are preconfigured because hosted placement on imported IFC geometry is not reliable in this environment. Do not redraw the floor slab, partition, doors, or windows. Rename or recreate the two rooms as Lobby and Office using room properties or a Room Schedule. Create real Revit model elements rather than visual-only detail lines or placeholder geometry. Use the Revit Room tool or editable imported room/space data for named rooms so they export as IFC spaces. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Revit's built-in IFC export. Use IFC4 if the export dialog asks for a setup, and enable room or space export if that option is available. The exported IFC should contain IfcSpace rooms named Lobby and Office; at least 1 building storey, at least 5 wall elements, at least 1 slab, at least 2 doors, at least 2 windows; no IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Other dimensions, exact coordinates, materials, family type names, wall thicknesses, and harmless metadata may vary.
